---
title: Scene Understanding
---

Scan the surroundings and list detected object labels. MediaPipe runs on the
selected camera input; in the simulator this normally means rendered-room
frames. Depth supports positioning the results in world space.

Handle an empty result while data or models load, when nothing is detected, or
when the required evidence is unavailable. The separate simulator ground-truth
override is not enabled by this template.

[Objects, people, and faces](/sdk/world/detection) · [Example catalog](/examples)
